# PDF Munk

PDF Munk provides APIs for generating, converting, editing, securing, and extracting content from PDFs and images.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pdf-munk/.

## Actions

- **Convert Images to PDF**: Combine one or more public images into a temporary hosted PDF in the supplied order, returning expiration metadata when available.
- **Convert PDF to Images**: Convert selected pages of a public PDF into temporary hosted PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.
- **Generate Image**: Generate a temporary hosted PNG image from a public webpage URL or raw HTML, returning its scheduled deletion date.
- **Generate PDF**: Generate a hosted PDF from either a public webpage URL or raw HTML, with practical page and rendering controls.
- **Merge PDFs**: Merge two to fifteen publicly accessible PDFs in the supplied order and return a temporary hosted PDF URL with its deletion date when…
- **OCR Image** (read-only): Extract text and line-level OCR results from an image available at a public URL.
- **OCR PDF** (read-only): Extract text from a scanned PDF available at a public URL using OCR controls.
- **Parse PDF** (read-only): Extract text, layout blocks, tables, or full structured content from a PDF available at a public URL.
- **Watermark File**: Add a text watermark to a PDF or image at a public URL and return a temporary hosted result URL.
